eval-bot: Nightly-eval ALERT: regression detected on 'storybench-v2' (failure rate 0.27 -> 0.62). Suspected cause: kernel v2.3.1 softmax normalizer tweak. See job 2155006789

alex: saw it. running local reproducer now. which prompt set shows the biggest spike?

priya: hemoglobin prompt group and a few conversational tests. outputs collapse into short repeats, low entropy. I landed a tiny clamp in the softmax normalizer to avoid overflow (commit abc1234). meant to be benign for normal ranges.

jamal: can you paste the exact change?

priya: ```diff
- float normalizer = max_logit;
- for (int i=0;i<n;i++) sum += exp(logit[i] - normalizer);
+ // clamp to avoid huge exponentials on pathological long sequences
+ float normalizer = max_logit + global_scale;
+ for (int i=0;i<n;i++) sum += exp(logit[i] - normalizer);
```

claire: that +global_scale looks like it shifts the baseline. possible effective temperature change. could reduce tail mass and cause greedy-like behaviour.

alex: repro notes: ran tools/nightly_repro --commit=abc1234 --prompt=hemoglobin --seed=42; sample length 50. saw immediate left-anchored repetition: "the patient reported pain pain pain" and top token prob >0.9 after token 6.

alex: sample snippet: "... the patient reported pain pain pain and and and continued ..."

morgan: q4/quant path didn't surface this in CI; seems float kernel path impacted only. suggests the clamp is active for fp32 path and not for quantized fast path.

priya: clamp was added because we had rare NaNs on very long sequences. I tried to keep global_scale tiny (1e-6) but maybe accumulation/precision interaction pushes it.

jamal: triage plan:
1) revert normalizer bump on canary and re-run nightly reproducer
2) add a regression unit that checks top-k entropy and KL to baseline for the hemoglobin prompts
3) instrument runtime to log normalizer and effective temperature for failing requests
4) if revert fixes, ship hotfix rollback and author a safer overflow guard that doesn't shift baseline

claire: I can add instrumentation into the attention kernel wrapper to emit: normalizer, sum_exp, effective_temp per request. low overhead on canary.

alex: I'll open a rollback PR and schedule canary. priya please prepare a follow-up fix with a test.

priya: PR created: https://git/repo/pull/4321 (rollback to kernel@abc1220). running local nightly now, will update in ~15m.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: eng-runtime-canary @ 22:30 UTC -> kernel@abc1220 (rollback).

alex: also let's add an eval harness assertion: for baseline prompts, KL_divergence(current, baseline) < 0.05 and top1_prob_mean delta < 0.03. Add to storybench config.

morgan: adding the assertions to storybench config and will run aggressor tests for quant and fp32 paths.

priya: thanks. if rollback passes I'll make a safer guard that uses scaling only when sum_exp > overflow_threshold, and tests for no baseline shift.

eval-bot: Nightly-eval: re-run scheduled in 30m for regressed suite (job 2155007500).

alex: good. we'll reconvene after the canary results. :thumbsup:
